name: stats-hud.scss
html:
// ─── Stats for Nerds HUD ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Fixed overlay anchored to the bottom-right corner above the nav bar.
// Non-interactive — pointer-events: none. Hidden by default.

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

$_B_STATS: 'stats-hud';

$_skel-border: rgba(
  255,
  255,
  255,
  0.18
); // separator — white alpha only (AGENTS.md shadow exception: no hex)
$_skel-label: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45); // dim label — white alpha only

.#{$_B_STATS} {
  position: fixed;
  right: to-rem($gap-272);
  bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
  z-index: var(--z-hud);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: to-rem($space-lg);

  padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-xl);
  border-radius: var(--radius-round);

  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.78); // pure black alpha — no theme hex
  backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-md)});
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(#{to-rem($space-md)});
  border: var(--border-item-hover);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);

  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: to-rem(0.2);
  color: $cms-accent;
  white-space: nowrap;
  pointer-events: auto;
  user-select: none;

  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(to-rem($space-sm));
  transition:
    opacity 0.25s ease,
    visibility 0.25s ease,
    transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

  // Match %MAXAREA gutter at each breakpoint
  @include layout-320() {
    right: to-rem($gap-320);
  }
  @include layout-375() {
    right: to-rem($gap-375);
  }
  @include layout-414() {
    right: to-rem($gap-414);
  }
  @include layout-540() {
    right: to-rem($gap-540);
  }
  @include layout-768() {
    right: to-rem($gap-768);
  }
  @include layout-960() {
    right: to-rem($gap-960);
  }
  @include layout-1024() {
    right: to-rem($gap-1024);
  }
  @include layout-1280() {
    right: to-rem($gap-1280);
  }
  @include layout-1440() {
    right: to-rem($gap-1440);
  }
  @include layout-1680() {
    right: to-rem($gap-1680);
  }
  @include layout-1920() {
    right: to-rem($gap-1920);
  }
  @include layout-2560() {
    right: to-rem($gap-2560);
  }

  &--visible {
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  // ── Mobile responsive: wrap into 2 rows, pin to grid gutters ────────────────
  // On ≤540px the segments in a single nowrap row overflow the viewport.
  // Pinning left+right to the grid gutter and using flex-wrap lets segments
  // stack naturally into multiple rows. Segment border-right separators are removed
  // at this size — they look broken at wrapped row-ends — row-gap handles spacing.
  @media (max-width: 540px) {
    right: to-rem($gap-272);
    left: to-rem($gap-272);
    max-width: none;
    white-space: normal;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-md);
    padding: to-rem($space-xs) to-rem($space-lg);
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);

    // Remove right-border separator on wrapped segments — it appears at row-ends
    // and looks misaligned when the last item in a row is not the last segment.
    &-segment:not(:last-child) {
      padding-right: 0;
      border-right: none;
    }
  }

  // Stat segments separated by a hairline border
  &-segment {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: to-rem($space-xs);

    &:not(:last-child) {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-lg);
      border-right: to-rem($space-hairline) solid $_skel-border;
    }
  }

  &-label {
    color: $_skel-label;
    font-size: to-rem($space-md);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(0.6);
  }

  &-value {
    color: $cms-accent;
    font-weight: 700;
  }

  // FPS color states — green when healthy, amber/red when low
  &-fps-good {
    color: $cms-badge-green;
  }
  &-fps-mid {
    color: $cms-badge-warn;
  }
  &-fps-bad {
    color: $cms-danger;
  }

  // AI acceleration color states
  &-accel-npu {
    color: $cms-badge-green;
  } // Hardware NPU — best
  &-accel-gpu {
    color: $cms-badge-warn;
  } // GPU WebGL fallback
  &-accel-wasm {
    color: $cms-accent;
  } // WASM software fallback
}
